notes: The registered command row is POS_DEAD at LVL_GOD; command dispatch owns the shared entry gate (R2/R5e).
The Go table preserves all 59 C rows, first-prefix order, levels, PC/NPC gates, and field types (R2/R5b/R5e).
Missing victim, field, or value framing reaches C's exact usage bytes (R1/R2/R5e).
The ordinary target path emits There is no such creature. and the optional player path is covered separately (R1/R5e).
A LVL_GOD actor may set gold but receives the C per-field rejection for GRGOD-only str (R1/R2/R5e).
First table match wins for abbreviated field names, including br, st, and cla (R2/R5e).
The player prefix selects exact global player lookup and keeps the normal PC field gates (R1/R2/R5e).
The mob prefix reaches get_char_vis and a registered visible NPC target; C's unused is_mob marker does not narrow the lookup (R1/R2/R5e).
An unknown field falls through the sentinel row and emits only Can't set that! (R1/R4/R5e).
Binary rows accept only exact lower-case on/yes/off/no and use the generic CAP'd field acknowledgement, including nosummon's inverse report (R1/R2/R5e).
Numeric rows use C atoi then the source RANGE bounds; the acknowledgement prints the clamped local value (R1/R3/R5e).
Title, sex, conditions, class, race, loadroom, and name-shaped values retain C misc parsing and terminal CRLF behavior (R1/R3/R5e).
Max resource fields and current hit/mana/move fields use their distinct C bounds and do not invent a Go-only hp alias (R1/R4/R5e).
The level arm rejects values at or above the actor before clamping and reports the shared C numeric acknowledgement on success (R1/R3/R5e).
A visible NPC exercises the BOTH field path, including C's final CAP on a lower-case short description and instance-local hit/gold state (R1/R3/R5e).
The vehicle proves exact sex/class/race validation, loadroom behavior, live passwd rejection, and the silent PC idnum return (R1/R2/R4/R5e).
The transport-aware path preserves internal and trailing value spacing through C's half_chop contract (R1/R3/R5e).
Invalid numeric suffixes become C atoi's parsed prefix and condition-specific is_number remains separately enforced (R3/R5e).
